description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that displays log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages, converts log levels to readable strings, handles thread-safe UI updates, and includes methods for chained log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays formatted log messages received through the LogNode interface, with support for chaining log nodes and thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, converting the priority to a string and appending exception details if present; updates the UI thread safely; passes logs to the next node if chained.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log message as a new line in the LogView.
